name: MoogLadder
description: Moog ladder filter emulation by Antti Huovilainen. 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass with self-oscillation. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: RLPFD
description: TB-303 style resonant low-pass filter with overdrive distortion. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: dist
inputs.description: Distortion amount applied within the filter

name: Streson
description: String resonance filter (Karplus-Strong-style comb resonator). Based on Victor Lazzarini's csound opcode of the same name. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Audio input signal to excite the resonator

name: NLFiltN
description: Non-linear filter with sigmoid clipping (non-interpolating). Implements Y[n] = a*Y[n-1] + b*Y[n-2] + d*Y[n-l]^2 + X[n] - c. Inherently unstable — pick sane values and move slowly. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: d
inputs.description: Coefficient for the squared delayed feedback term Y[n-l]^2

inputs.name: c
inputs.description: DC offset subtracted from the difference equation

inputs.name: l
inputs.description: Delay length (in samples) for the squared feedback term

name: NLFiltL
description: Non-linear filter with sigmoid clipping (linear-interpolating). Variant of NLFiltN with linear interpolation on the delayed feedback. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: d
inputs.description: Coefficient for the squared delayed feedback term Y[n-l]^2

inputs.name: c
inputs.description: DC offset subtracted from the difference equation

inputs.name: l
inputs.description: Delay length (in samples) for the squared feedback term

name: NLFiltC
description: Non-linear filter with sigmoid clipping (cubic-interpolating). Variant of NLFiltN with cubic interpolation on the delayed feedback. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: d
inputs.description: Coefficient for the squared delayed feedback term Y[n-l]^2

inputs.name: c
inputs.description: DC offset subtracted from the difference equation

inputs.name: l
inputs.description: Delay length (in samples) for the squared feedback term

name: TGrains2
description: Buffer granulator with linear attack/decay envelope. Triggers spawn grains from a mono buffer with adjustable attack and decay times. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: numChannels
inputs.description: Number of output channels (panning depends on count: 1=ignored, 2=Pan2, >2=PanAz)

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Trigger signal — each rising edge starts a new grain

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Index of the mono buffer to read grains from

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Playback rate multiplier (1.0 = normal; multiplied internally by BufRate)

inputs.name: centerPos
inputs.description: Position in seconds at which the grain envelope reaches maximum amplitude

inputs.name: pan
inputs.description: Pan position for the grain (interpretation depends on numChannels)

inputs.name: att
inputs.description: Attack time of the grain envelope in seconds

inputs.name: dec
inputs.description: Decay time of the grain envelope in seconds

name: TGrains3
description: Buffer granulator with user-supplied window envelope. Like TGrains2 but the grain envelope is read from an additional buffer. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Trigger signal — each rising edge starts a new grain

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Index of the mono audio buffer

inputs.name: centerPos
inputs.description: Position in seconds where the envelope peaks

inputs.name: att
inputs.description: Attack time of the grain envelope in seconds

inputs.name: dec
inputs.description: Decay time of the grain envelope in seconds

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Buffer number containing the user envelope window

name: Dbrown2
description: Demand-rate brownian movement using Gendyn distributions. Returns numbers in the continuous range [lo, hi] with steps shaped by the chosen Gendy distribution. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value of the output range

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value of the output range

inputs.name: dist
inputs.description: Gendyn distribution index (see Gendy1 for the available distributions)

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to produce (effectively infinite by default)

name: Dgauss
description: Demand-rate gaussian random number generator. Returns floats in [lo, hi] drawn from a gaussian-like distribution. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value of the output range

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value of the output range

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to produce (effectively infinite by default)

name: GaussTrig
description: Gaussian-distributed impulse generator. Produces impulses near a centre frequency, with timing jitter controlled by deviation. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: TBetaRand
description: Triggered beta-distribution random generator. Emits a new value in [lo, hi] on each rising edge of trig, with shape controlled by prob1/prob2. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value of the output range

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value of the output range

inputs.name: prob1
inputs.description: Shape parameter biasing toward lo (lower than 1 pushes values toward lo)

inputs.name: prob2
inputs.description: Shape parameter biasing toward hi (lower than 1 pushes values toward hi)

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger signal — each rising edge produces a new value

name: TBrownRand
description: Triggered brownian random walk generator. On each trigger emits a value within [lo, hi] obtained by stepping from the previous value using a Gendyn distribution. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value of the output range

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value of the output range

inputs.name: dev
inputs.description: Maximum step size between successive values

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger signal — each rising edge produces a new value

name: TGaussRand
description: Triggered gaussian random distribution. Emits a gaussian-distributed value in [lo, hi] on each rising edge of trig. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value of the output range

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value of the output range

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger signal — each rising edge produces a new value

name: Gendy4
description: Dynamic stochastic synthesis generator (Xenakis Gendyn variant). Adds a sigmoid mapping for amplitude/duration distributions. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: initCPs
inputs.description: Initial number of control points in the breakpoint waveform

inputs.name: knum
inputs.description: Active control point count (must be <= initCPs)

name: Gendy5
description: Dynamic stochastic synthesis generator with linearly-interpolated breakpoints. Sibling of Gendy4 with a different waveform reconstruction. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Henon2DN
description: Hénon map 2D chaotic generator (non-interpolating). x[n+1] = 1 - a*x[n]^2 + y[n], y[n+1] = b*x[n]. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Henon2DL
description: Hénon map 2D chaotic generator (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Henon2DC
description: Hénon map 2D chaotic generator (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: HenonTrig
description: Hénon map chaotic trigger generator. Same iteration as Henon2DN but with low-frequency defaults intended for triggering. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Gbman2DN
description: Gingerbreadman map 2D chaotic generator (non-interpolating). x[n+1] = 1 - y[n] + |x[n]|, y[n+1] = x[n]. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Gbman2DL
description: Gingerbreadman map 2D chaotic generator (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Gbman2DC
description: Gingerbreadman map 2D chaotic generator (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: GbmanTrig
description: Gingerbreadman chaotic trigger generator. Low-frequency defaults intended for triggering. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Standard2DN
description: Chirikov standard map 2D chaotic generator (non-interpolating). y[n+1] = (y[n] + k*sin(x[n])) mod 2π, x[n+1] = (x[n] + y[n+1]) mod 2π. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Standard2DL
description: Chirikov standard map 2D chaotic generator (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Standard2DC
description: Chirikov standard map 2D chaotic generator (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: StandardTrig
description: Chirikov standard map chaotic trigger generator. Low-frequency defaults intended for triggering. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Latoocarfian2DN
description: Latoocarfian 2D chaotic generator (non-interpolating). x[n+1] = sin(b*y[n]) + c*sin(b*x[n]); y[n+1] = sin(a*x[n]) + d*sin(a*y[n]). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Latoocarfian2DL
description: Latoocarfian 2D chaotic generator (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Latoocarfian2DC
description: Latoocarfian 2D chaotic generator (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: LatoocarfianTrig
description: Latoocarfian chaotic trigger generator. Low-frequency defaults intended for triggering. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Lorenz2DN
description: Lorenz 3D chaotic system, output projected to 2D (non-interpolating). Integrated by Euler step h: x' = s*(y-x); y' = x*(r-z) - y; z' = x*y - b*z. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Lorenz2DL
description: Lorenz attractor 2D chaotic generator (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Lorenz2DC
description: Lorenz attractor 2D chaotic generator (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: LorenzTrig
description: Lorenz attractor chaotic trigger generator. Same dynamics as Lorenz2DN, used to derive triggers. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: Fhn2DN
description: FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron-firing oscillator (non-interpolating). 2D excitable model with input current i. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: urate
inputs.description: Update rate of the membrane potential u

inputs.name: wrate
inputs.description: Update rate of the recovery variable w

inputs.name: i
inputs.description: External input current driving the neuron

name: Fhn2DL
description: FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron-firing oscillator (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: urate
inputs.description: Update rate of the membrane potential u

inputs.name: wrate
inputs.description: Update rate of the recovery variable w

name: Fhn2DC
description: FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron-firing oscillator (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: urate
inputs.description: Update rate of the membrane potential u

inputs.name: wrate
inputs.description: Update rate of the recovery variable w

name: FhnTrig
description: FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron-based trigger generator. Same dynamics as Fhn2DN, with low-frequency defaults intended for triggering. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: urate
inputs.description: Update rate of the membrane potential u

inputs.name: wrate
inputs.description: Update rate of the recovery variable w

name: LFBrownNoise0
description: Low-frequency brownian random walk (no interpolation). Steps between random values at freq using Gendyn distribution dist. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: dist
inputs.description: Gendyn distribution index for step shape

name: LFBrownNoise1
description: Low-frequency brownian random walk (linear-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: dist
inputs.description: Gendyn distribution index for step shape

name: LFBrownNoise2
description: Low-frequency brownian random walk (cubic-interpolating). From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: dist
inputs.description: Gendyn distribution index for step shape

name: PV_CommonMag
description: Spectral processing: returns the bins whose magnitudes are within tolerance of each other in two FFT chains, optionally removing the rest. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Magnitude difference tolerance for matching bins

inputs.name: remove
inputs.description: If non-zero, removes non-matching bins from bufferA

name: PV_CommonMul
description: Spectral processing: multiplies the magnitudes of bins common to two FFT chains, optionally removing the rest. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Magnitude difference tolerance for matching bins

inputs.name: remove
inputs.description: If non-zero, removes non-matching bins from bufferA

name: PV_Compander
description: Simple spectral compressor/expander. Bins above thresh are scaled by slopeAbove; bins below are scaled by slopeBelow. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: slopeBelow
inputs.description: Compression/expansion slope for bins below thresh

inputs.name: slopeAbove
inputs.description: Compression/expansion slope for bins above thresh

name: PV_Cutoff
description: Spectral cutoff: zeros bins above (or below) a wipe position with smooth interpolation. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: wipe
inputs.description: Wipe position from -1 (low cut) to 1 (high cut)

name: PV_MagGate
description: Spectral gate: zeros bins below or above thresh, optionally removing them entirely. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: remove
inputs.description: If non-zero, gates ABOVE thresh instead of below

name: PV_MagMinus
description: Spectral subtraction: subtracts the magnitudes of bufferB from bufferA, clamped at zero. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT buffer the result is written to

inputs.name: remove
inputs.description: If non-zero, removes bins of bufferA whose magnitude becomes <= 0

name: PV_MagScale
description: Spectral scaling: multiplies the magnitudes of bufferA by the magnitudes of bufferB. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT buffer the result is written to

inputs.name: bufferB
inputs.description: FFT buffer providing the scaling magnitudes

name: PV_Morph
description: Spectral morphing between two FFT chains. morph in [0, 1] interpolates magnitudes/phases from bufferA to bufferB. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

name: PV_SoftWipe
description: Spectral wipe: combines low bins from one input and high bins from the other with interpolation in the crossover region. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT buffer providing the low-bin region (and result destination)

inputs.name: bufferB
inputs.description: FFT buffer providing the high-bin region

inputs.name: wipe
inputs.description: Wipe position from -1 (all bufferA) to 1 (all bufferB)

name: PV_XFade
description: Spectral crossfade: linearly interpolates between two FFT chains. From sc3-plugins BhobUGens.
